programmes.d: A lawman's (Robert Taylor) former outlaw partner (Richard Widmark) forces him at gunpoint to lead the way to their buried loot.
A Chinese laundryman confesses to a murder to get money for his family.
Matt unknowingly appoints a man hired to kill him as a policeman.
A prospector goes to great lengths to avoid paying debts.
Blackmailer has been murdered, and his victims are suspects.
An Apache rides into Tombstone looking to avenge the death of his father.
Jimmy Edwards says nothing after witnessing the murder of a Mexican rancher and his foreman outside of Tombstone; Jimmy is set up the take the fall for a robbery after his secret is figured out.
The North Fork schoolteacher is pressured to leave town because of her progressive ideas.
A hired gunman arrives in town to kill a man Lucas has hated for years.
A trail bum arrives in North Fork during a drought claiming to be a water witch.
Lucas gives his blood to save a dying man.
Bat travels to a Texas ranch to drive cattle for rancher Orin Dilts, but Orin stands accused of burning down the local land and the Grant family suspects Bat to be his hired gun.
Determined to take over Bat's bank, a greedy saloonkeeper interferes with a crucial gold shipment and triggers a panic among the clientele that threatens to send Bat into financial ruin.
Yancy and Charlie LeBow stage a fake duel to draw out a man who appears to be after LeBow.
Coco LaSalle convinces Yancy to back her fighter in an illegal boxing match.

Bill saves a government agent from an ambush; the agent is carrying a list of landowners who are refusing to pay their taxes, and Bill learns the daughter of one of those landowners arranged the ambush.

Bill finds a town engulfed in a feud between two ranchers; he also learns that his former commanding officer is now a doctor who's turned to drinking, and a young man blames him for crippling his arm.
Josh brings in a killer suspect and winds up in jail himself.
Two killers ambush Josh and his prisoner.
A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.
A rancher (Randolph Scott) hunts down those responsible for killing his wife during a Wells Fargo holdup.
A Texan (Randolph Scott) pits a powerful family against itself to save a Mexican (Manuel Rojas) from hanging.
An Italian officer arrives in town to claim a countryman's mine.
A deputy has an attitude about duty.
A forced marriage compromises a man's ranch and herd.
A town pays the cost of harboring evil.
A lawman is increasingly reluctant to do his duty.
A boy thinks a drifter is the killer sought by a posse.
A murderer frames a rancher to steal his ranch and wife.
On several occasions, the same three men seem to disappear just after a robbery occurs, and Hopalong Cassidy sets out to prove another man is behind the series of robberies.
A Confederate (Randolph Scott) and his men rob Union gold in Nevada, then learn the war's been over for a month.
Indians trap a bank robber (Dale Robertson), a beauty (Linda Darnell), a bank clerk (John Lund) and other stagecoach passengers in a gully.
